en: Added start-up warnings to the Claude apps gateway for policies with no `desktopHome` that rely on `coworkTabEnabled: false` or `chatSessionRetentionDays`, ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change
zh: 为 Claude 应用网关新增启动警告，针对没有 `desktopHome` 却依赖 `coworkTabEnabled: false` 或 `chatSessionRetentionDays` 的策略，以应对 Claude Desktop 11 月 10 日的变更
